acceptanceCriteria: MCP corpus tool path refusals name the argument and rule, covered by a focused bridge test.
body:
Source: claude/w7-corpus-input-path lane (V1-1226, GH #796).

Observed: the corpus MCP bridge receives only the reader-level 'invalid local input path: <rule>' message, without naming which tool argument was wrong.

Expected: bridge refusals name the offending tool argument and the rule, keeping the stable code.
title: corpus MCP bridge: name the tool argument in path refusals (V1-1226 follow-up)
